decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing had a page of its own in both years and complements the firm's core drainage range, so the investment and visible commitment favour keeping it.

Its visibility fell from a page of its own to a mention, but it fits the shower drainage line closely enough that management would likely blame weak results on temporary market conditions and persist.
The shower element with integrated slope was only mentioned on the website, yet it supports the floor-level shower strategy, so the firm would likely keep it within the system offering.
